about: Hand validation of the support rule (eval/metrics.ts). grounded = the story states, or translates to, everything the sentence claims. Round 1 used the rule as specified; precision was under 80%, so the rule was revised once and re-validated on a fresh sample (round 2).

rounds.rule: supported if >= 50% of content words (4+ letters, not stopwords, 5-char prefix) occur in the story
